struct HashSplitter {
    static uint64_t splitmix64(uint64_t x) {
        x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
        x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;

    }

        static const uint64_t seed = splitmix64(chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count() * (get_random_address() | 1));
        return splitmix64(x ^ seed);
    }
};

const int MOD_CONST = 1e9 + 7;

struct Modular {
    int value;

    Modular(long long v = 0) {
        if (v < 0) v = v % MOD_CONST + MOD_CONST;
        if (v >= MOD_CONST) v %= MOD_CONST;
        value = v;
    }

    static int extended_gcd(int a, int m, int &x, int &y) {
        if (m == 0) {
            x = 1; y = 0;
            return a;
        }
        int g = extended_gcd(m, a % m, y, x);
        y -= (a / m) * x;
        return g;
    }

    static int modular_inverse(int a, int m = MOD_CONST) {
        int x, y;
        extended_gcd(a, m, x, y);
        return (x % m + m) % m;
    }

    explicit operator int() const { return value; }

        value += other.value;
        if (value >= MOD_CONST) value -= MOD_CONST;

        value -= other.value;
        if (value < 0) value += MOD_CONST;
        return *this;
    }

        value = (uint64_t(value) * other.value) % MOD_CONST;
        return *this;
    }

    Modular& operator/=(const Modular &other) {
        return *this *= Modular(modular_inverse(other.value));
    }
